about_the_game:
Dicey Decisions is a multiplayer, strategy based board game where you compete against another person through cards, dice, and collecting runes and points. The game ends at round 6, and the person who gets the most wins! But watch out for your exhaustion levels!

Dicey Decisions is a game created around the idea of a kid's understanding of the classic game Dungeons and Dragons. The game uses dice as its core resource, used for both movement and card effects, reflecting the use of dice for actions in DnD.

Roll and collect dice each round, use those dice to gather more resources and reputation, beat your opponent!

Features

  • Multiplayer: Compete against your friend in a 1v1 match to see who can outsmart the other! Utilize the cards in your inventory based off your character, and collect the necessary dice and runes to play them.

  • Cards: Activate card effects to gain reputation to push you closer to victory!

  • Player Abilities: Each player has their own special skill, figure out how to use your skill to gain the upperhand on your rival!
